corrections.after: Mercantile/Diplomatic Connection reducing a check to zero dice means failure. Company Fraud is played at the start of Revenue: roll one die per your officeholder, reduce Company Balance by twice the highest roll but not below zero, and take only the amount actually removed from the bank. Thus Balance £10 and highest roll 6 gives Balance £0 and a £10 payout, not £12. Public Demands Impeachment returns the officeholder to supply and office card to Vacant Offices. Military Oversight demotes Commander to officer, making that former Commander eligible for reappointment.
corrections.reason: Verified designer ruling resolves previously ambiguous capped payout; stricter source-backed key, not reader-driven relaxation.
